changes.text: The author's inference is that, set side by side, the two lines show one test: recover the ground, but leave no handle for the other side. In the first year of Guangxu the fear was that cession would damage prestige and feed disorder; here, that an army acting without right would hand Russia its excuse. One reading is that he judged a move by whether it could be held afterwards and defended in argument, not only by the land it gained. The biography draws no such conclusion.
作者推断，这两句放在一起可以看出一条一致的标准：地要收回，但不能留下把柄。光绪元年讲的是割弃会挫国威、长乱，此处讲的是师不以正会让对方有辞。一种解释是，他衡量一个动作，不只看得地多少，还看事后守不守得住、辩不辩得清。传记本身未作此归纳。

dispositions.rationale: 英文原作 "not by the land it gained"，等于完全排除得地多少，比中文“不只看得地多少，还看……”更强，也与左宗棠明言要收回旧地相矛盾。现将英文改为 "not only by the land it gained"，与中文语义一致。中文本身无误，按中英同步规则原文照录。

evidence.quote: 不及時規還國家舊所沒地
